# Taitung.md

> An open-source knowledge base about Taitung, the most culturally diverse
> county in Taiwan. Home to 7 indigenous peoples, prehistoric heritage,
> and a landscape stretching from Pacific shores to 3,000m peaks.

## Built from
National Taitung University (NTTU), the only national university in
southeastern Taiwan, with contributions from students, researchers,
local communities, and indigenous elders.

## What makes Taitung unique
- 7 indigenous peoples: Amis, Paiwan, Bunun, Puyuma, Rukai, Tao (Yami), Kavalan
- Peinan Archaeological Site: largest prehistoric burial in Pacific Rim
- Elevation range: sea level to Jiaming Lake at 3,310m
- International Balloon Festival, Slow City (Chishang), digital nomad hub

## Content structure
Articles are organized by "landscape layers" - overlapping perspectives
on the same geography: Land, Time, People, Knowledge, Living,
Celebration, Experience, Youth, Design, Education, Sustainability, Connection.

## Endpoints
- /api/articles - Full article index with coordinates (JSON)
- /api/layers - Layer definitions and article mappings
